resources.string: Automatically remind every new vivo Recorder recording 10 minutes after it is saved, including recordings started with Volume Down.

Existing recordings and recordings saved while this is off are ignored. Turning this off stops monitoring; reminders already created stay scheduled. Originals stay in Recorder; SpeakAlert’s copies expire after one week.
Requires audio and notification access. A silent ongoing notification keeps the monitor active while the screen is off. Allow SpeakAlert to run in the background in vivo’s battery settings.
This integration requires Android 10 or newer and vivo Recorder.
